sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant Browser as Web Browser
    participant Gallery as Gallery UI
    participant Modal as Detail Modal
    participant Mgmt as Management Area
    participant Store as Local Storage
    User->>Browser: Load index.html via Live Server
    Browser->>Gallery: Render item gallery (FR-CAT-01)
    Gallery-->>User: Display gallery of items
    User->>Gallery: Click an item
    Gallery->>Modal: Open modal with full details (SC-CAT-01)
    Modal-->>User: Show full details and larger image
    User->>Modal: Close modal
    Modal-->>Gallery: Return to gallery (SC-CAT-02)
    User->>Gallery: Enter keyword in search bar
    Gallery->>Gallery: Filter items in real-time (FR-SRCH-01)
    Gallery-->>User: Show only matching items
    User->>Gallery: Select category from filter dropdown
    Gallery->>Gallery: Filter by category (FR-FILT-01)
    Gallery-->>User: Show items of selected category
    User->>Gallery: Toggle Available Only
    Gallery->>Gallery: Hide unavailable items (FR-FILT-02)
    Gallery-->>User: Show only available items
    User->>Gallery: Change sort order to Price Low to High
    Gallery->>Gallery: Reorder items instantly (FR-SORT-01)
    Gallery-->>User: Display reordered items without reload
    User->>Mgmt: Open management area and add new item
    Mgmt->>Store: Save new item (FR-CRUD-01)
    Store-->>Mgmt: Confirm save
    Mgmt->>Gallery: Update gallery immediately
    Gallery-->>User: Show new item in gallery
    User->>Mgmt: Edit existing item price and save
    Mgmt->>Store: Update item price (FR-CRUD-02)
    Store-->>Mgmt: Confirm update
    Mgmt->>Gallery: Reflect updated price
    Gallery-->>User: Show updated price in gallery
    User->>Mgmt: Delete an item
    Mgmt->>Store: Remove item (FR-CRUD-03)
    Store-->>Mgmt: Confirm deletion
    Mgmt->>Gallery: Remove item from gallery
    Gallery-->>User: Item removed from view
    User->>Browser: Refresh the page
    Browser->>Store: Load persisted items (FR-PERS-01)
    Store-->>Browser: Return saved items
    Browser->>Gallery: Render gallery with persisted data
    Gallery-->>User: Added item is still present

flowchart TD
    START["Start: Start Live Server on index.html"] --> LOAD["Load index.html in browser"]
    LOAD --> DISPLAY["Gallery displays items - FR-CAT-01"]
    DISPLAY --> DEC_SEARCH{"User wants to search or filter?"}
    DEC_SEARCH -->|"Yes"| SEARCH["Enter keyword or select filter - FR-SRCH-01, FR-FILT-01, FR-FILT-02"]
    SEARCH --> SORT_DEC{"Change sort order?"}
    SORT_DEC -->|"Yes"| SORT["Reorder items instantly - FR-SORT-01"]
    SORT --> DEC_SEARCH
    SORT_DEC -->|"No"| DEC_SEARCH
    DEC_SEARCH -->|"No"| DEC_CRUD{"Perform CRUD operation?"}
    DEC_CRUD -->|"Add"| ADD["Open management area and add new item - FR-CRUD-01"]
    ADD --> UPDATE_GALLERY1["Gallery updates immediately"]
    UPDATE_GALLERY1 --> DEC_PERSIST{"Verify persistence?"}
    DEC_CRUD -->|"Edit"| EDIT["Edit existing item price and save - FR-CRUD-02"]
    EDIT --> UPDATE_GALLERY2["Gallery reflects updated price"]
    UPDATE_GALLERY2 --> DEC_PERSIST
    DEC_CRUD -->|"Delete"| DELETE["Delete an item - FR-CRUD-03"]
    DELETE --> UPDATE_GALLERY3["Item removed from gallery"]
    UPDATE_GALLERY3 --> DEC_PERSIST
    DEC_CRUD -->|"No"| DEC_PERSIST
    DEC_PERSIST -->|"Yes"| REFRESH["Refresh the page"]
    REFRESH --> CHECK_PERSIST{"Added item still present?"}
    CHECK_PERSIST -->|"Yes - FR-PERS-01"| END["End: Validation successful"]
    CHECK_PERSIST -->|"No"| DEBUG["Debug persistence layer"]
    DEBUG --> ADD
    DEC_PERSIST -->|"No"| END
